caption: A bowl of miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with visible foam. Topped with a whole boiled egg, chashu pork, shredded green onions, and red threads, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth, polished surface.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned surface and visible marbling, cut into irregular shape.
A whole boiled egg, pale cream-colored, smooth and glossy surface, slightly oval shape, subtle light reflections.
The miso broth is amber-brown, frothy, and contains noodles, green onions, and red threads, with a slightly uneven surface.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner rim staining.
